title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A1–B1）
section: 第 251–300 個單字（CEFR A1 基礎入門）

examples.en: Feel free to ask questions if you don't understand.
examples.zh: 如果你不懂，請隨時發問。

examples.en: The tourist asked the police officer for directions to Taipei 101.
examples.zh: 觀光客向警察詢問前往台北 101 的路線方向。

examples.en: Can I ask you for a small favor?
examples.zh: 我可以請你幫個小忙嗎？

examples.en: She raised her hand to answer the teacher's question.
examples.zh: 她舉手回答老師的問題。

examples.en: He answered the telephone on the very first ring.
examples.zh: 電話剛響第一聲他就接了起來。

examples.en: Check your answers carefully before handing in the exam sheet.
examples.zh: 繳交試卷前請仔細檢查你的答案。

examples.en: I think English is interesting and useful.
examples.zh: 我認為英文很有趣也很實用。

examples.en: Take some time to think carefully before making a major decision.
examples.zh: 在做重大決定之前，花點時間深思熟慮。

examples.en: I think so too; that seems like the most practical solution.
examples.zh: 我也這麼認為，這似乎是最切實可行的方案。

examples.en: Do you know where the nearest post office is?
examples.zh: 你知道最近的郵局在哪裡嗎？

examples.en: I have known my best friend since kindergarten.
examples.zh: 我從小學幼兒園就認識了我最好的朋友。

examples.en: The more you read, the more you will know about the world.
examples.zh: 閱讀得越多，你對這個世界的認識就越豐富。

examples.en: Children learn languages very quickly.
examples.zh: 小孩學習語言非常快。

examples.en: We can learn valuable lessons from our past mistakes.
examples.zh: 我們能從過去的錯誤中學到寶貴的經驗。

examples.en: She wants to learn how to play the classical guitar this summer.
examples.zh: 她想在今年夏天學習彈奏古典吉他。

examples.en: Mr. Wu teaches us mathematics and science.
examples.zh: 吳老師教我們數學和自然科學。

examples.en: Experience is the best teacher in life.
examples.zh: 經驗是人生最好的老師。

examples.en: My older brother taught me how to swim when I was eight.
examples.zh: 我哥哥在我八歲時教我學會了游泳。

examples.en: I usually study in the library after school.
examples.zh: 我放學後通常在圖書館讀書。

examples.en: Recent scientific studies show that sleep is vital for memory.
examples.zh: 近期科學研究顯示睡眠對記憶力至關重要。

examples.en: He decided to study abroad in Canada for high school.
examples.zh: 他決定高中前往加拿大留學深造。

examples.en: My father works at a tech company in Hsinchu.
examples.zh: 我父親在新竹的一家科技公司上班。

examples.en: Hard work and persistence will eventually pay off.
examples.zh: 辛勤工作與持之以恆終將換來回報。

examples.en: That medication worked wonders and cured my headache.
examples.zh: 那種藥效神奇，治好了我的頭痛。

examples.en: We often play basketball on Friday afternoons.
examples.zh: 我們經常在週五下午打籃球。

examples.en: She plays the piano with great skill and emotion.
examples.zh: 她彈鋼琴技巧純熟且充滿情感。

examples.en: Our school drama club will put on a Shakespeare play next month.
examples.zh: 我們學校話劇社下個月將上演莎士比亞戲劇。

examples.en: I like milk tea with less sugar and no ice.
examples.zh: 我喜歡微糖去冰的奶茶。

examples.en: He looks just like his father when he smiles.
examples.zh: 他微笑時看起來就像他父親一樣。

examples.en: What would you like to have for dinner tonight?
examples.zh: 你今晚晚餐想吃點什麼呢？

examples.en: I love traveling around Taiwan by train.
examples.zh: 我喜歡搭火車環島旅行。

examples.en: Parents show unconditional love to their growing children.
examples.zh: 父母對成長中的孩子展現了無條件的愛。

examples.en: They fell in love during their college volunteer program.
examples.zh: 他們在大學志工服務活動中相戀了。

examples.en: I hate getting up early on rainy mornings.
examples.zh: 我討厭在下雨的早晨起大早。

examples.en: She hates crowded night markets on scorching summer evenings.
examples.zh: 她討厭在炎熱夏夜逛擁擠的夜市。

examples.en: There is no room for hatred and prejudice in our school community.
examples.zh: 我們的校園群體容不下仇恨與偏見。

examples.en: We really enjoyed our trip to Kenting.
examples.zh: 我們非常享受去墾丁的旅行。

examples.en: Did you enjoy reading that fantasy mystery book?
examples.zh: 你喜歡閱讀那本奇幻懸疑小說嗎？

examples.en: Please enjoy yourselves at the evening welcome party!
examples.zh: 今晚的迎新派對請大家盡情玩得開心！

examples.en: I want to order a bowl of beef noodles.
examples.zh: 我想要點一碗牛肉麵。

examples.en: Do you want to join our study group this semester?
examples.zh: 這學期你想加入我們的讀書小組嗎？

examples.en: The charity provides warm coats to families in want during winter.
examples.zh: 該慈善機構在冬季為貧困家庭提供保暖大衣。

examples.en: You need to practice speaking English every day.
examples.zh: 你需要每天練習開口說英語。

examples.en: A friend in need is a friend indeed.
examples.zh: 患難見真情。

examples.en: We need three more chairs for the guests in the living room.
examples.zh: 我們客廳裡還需要三張椅子給客人坐。

examples.en: I hope you have a wonderful weekend!
examples.zh: 希望你有個美好的週末！

examples.en: We hope that tomorrow will be sunny for our school field trip.
examples.zh: 我們希望明天校外教學是個大晴天。

examples.en: Never lose hope even when facing challenging circumstances.
examples.zh: 即使面對具挑戰性的處境，也絕不要失去希望。

examples.en: We wish you a Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!
examples.zh: 我們祝你聖誕快樂、新年如意！

examples.en: Close your eyes and make a special birthday wish.
examples.zh: 閉上眼睛，許下一個特別的生日願望。

examples.en: Send my warmest best wishes to your family members.
examples.zh: 代我向你的家人致上最誠摯溫馨的祝福。

examples.en: I live with my family in Kaohsiung City.
examples.zh: 我和家人住在高雄市。

examples.en: Marine creatures live in deep coral reef ecosystems.
examples.zh: 海洋生物棲息在深海珊瑚礁生態系中。

examples.en: Millions of viewers watched the live broadcast of the sports finals.
examples.zh: 數百萬觀眾收看了這場體育決賽的現場直播。

examples.en: Stay home if you catch a bad cold.
examples.zh: 如果你重感冒，請待在家裡。

examples.en: We stayed at a comfortable resort during our vacation in Hualien.
examples.zh: 在花蓮度假期間我們住在一家舒適的度假村。

examples.en: Don't stay up late cramming the night before an important exam.
examples.zh: 重要考試前一晚切莫熬夜死記硬背。

examples.en: Please wait here until your number is called.
examples.zh: 請在這裡等候直到叫到你的號碼。

examples.en: I cannot wait to see my best friend after summer vacation.
examples.zh: 暑假結束後我迫不及待想見到最好的朋友。

examples.en: We waited patiently in line for the popular bakery to open.
examples.zh: 我們耐心地排隊等待這家人氣麵包店開門。

examples.en: Have a good day at school!
examples.zh: 祝你在學校有美好的一天！

examples.en: She is very good at playing badminton and table tennis.
examples.zh: 她非常擅長打羽毛球和桌球。

examples.en: Brainstorming with teammates is a great way to generate good ideas.
examples.zh: 與隊友集思廣益是產生好點子的絕佳方式。

examples.en: Eating too much fried food is bad for your health.
examples.zh: 吃太多油炸食物對健康有害。

examples.en: The bad weather forced the airline to delay all outbound flights.
examples.zh: 惡劣的天氣迫使航空公司延誤了所有出港航班。

examples.en: He had a bad dream and woke up startled in the middle of the night.
examples.zh: 他做了一個噩夢，在半夜驚醒。

examples.en: Taipei 101 is a very big skyscraper.
examples.zh: 台北 101 是一棟非常巨大的摩天大樓。

examples.en: Passing the entrance examination was a big milestone in her life.
examples.zh: 通過入學考試是她人生中的一個重大里程碑。

examples.en: The smiling child greeted his grandparents with a big hug.
examples.zh: 面帶微笑的孩子給了祖父母一個大大的擁抱。

examples.en: Our apartment has a small but cozy balcony.
examples.zh: 我們的公寓有一個小巧但舒適的陽台。

examples.en: Making small improvements every day leads to massive long-term progress.
examples.zh: 每天做出微小的進步能帶來巨大的長期成果。

examples.en: They engaged in friendly small talk while waiting for the elevator.
examples.zh: 等電梯時他們進行了親切的閒聊寒暄。

examples.en: Summer in southern Taiwan is very hot.
examples.zh: 台灣南部的夏天非常炎熱。

examples.en: Enjoying a hot spring bath is relaxing in cold winter weather.
examples.zh: 在寒冷的冬日裡享受溫泉泡湯非常放鬆。

examples.en: Be careful not to burn your tongue on the hot soup.
examples.zh: 小心別被滾燙的熱湯燙到舌頭。

examples.en: Drink warm water when you have a cold.
examples.zh: 感冒時請多喝溫水。

examples.en: Winter nights in the mountains can get extremely cold.
examples.zh: 山區冬天的夜晚會變得極度寒冷。

examples.en: Catching a cold can be prevented by washing hands regularly.
examples.zh: 經常洗手有助於預防感冒。

examples.en: Spring brings warm sunshine and blooming flowers.
examples.zh: 春天帶來溫暖的陽光和綻放的花朵。

examples.en: She gave her guests a warm and enthusiastic welcome.
examples.zh: 她對客人給予了溫馨熱誠的歡迎。

examples.en: Remember to warm up your muscles before running the sprint.
examples.zh: 短跑衝刺前記得先把肌肉熱身開來。

examples.en: Autumn evenings are pleasantly cool.
examples.zh: 秋天的夜晚涼爽宜人。

examples.en: That leather motorcycle jacket looks extraordinarily cool.
examples.zh: 那件騎士皮夾克看起來酷極了。

examples.en: Keep your cool and think logically when unexpected problems arise.
examples.zh: 發生意想不到的問題時，保持冷靜並理性思考。

examples.en: I bought a new pair of sneakers yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天買了一雙新球鞋。

examples.en: We welcome three new students to our class this semester.
examples.zh: 我們這學期迎來了三位轉入班上的新同學。

examples.en: The company introduced a brand new smartphone model with advanced cameras.
examples.zh: 該公司推出了一款配備先進相機的全新智慧型手機。

examples.en: Tainan is famous for its old historic temples.
examples.zh: 台南以其古老的歷史廟宇聞名。

examples.en: How old will your younger brother turn next month?
examples.zh: 你弟弟下個月將滿幾歲？

examples.en: She loves listening to old vinyl records from the nineteen eighties.
examples.zh: 她喜歡聽八零年代的老黑膠唱片。

examples.en: Many young people enjoy playing online games.
examples.zh: 許多年輕人喜歡玩線上遊戲。

examples.en: When I was young, I spent summer holidays catching cicadas in the orchard.
examples.zh: 當我年幼時，整個暑假都在果園裡抓蟬玩耍。

examples.en: The young artist won an award for her creative landscape paintings.
examples.zh: 這位年輕藝術家以其富創意的風景畫作榮獲獎項。

examples.en: She was very happy to receive the gift.
examples.zh: 收到那份禮物她非常開心。

examples.en: Wishing you a very Happy Birthday filled with joy and laughter!
examples.zh: 祝你生日快樂，充滿歡笑與喜悅！

examples.en: Reading bedtime stories with their children makes parents truly happy.
examples.zh: 與孩子共讀床邊故事讓為人父母者由衷感到幸福。

examples.en: Don't be sad; everything will be fine.
examples.zh: 別難過，一切都會好起來的。

examples.en: The movie had a very sad ending that brought tears to our eyes.
examples.zh: 這部電影有一個非常令人感傷的結局，讓我們潸然淚下。

examples.en: Listening to the sad song reminded him of his departed childhood pet.
examples.zh: 聽這首憂傷的歌曲讓他想起了離開的兒時寵物。

examples.en: Mom was angry because I didn't finish my homework.
examples.zh: 媽媽很生氣因為我沒寫完功課。

examples.en: Take a deep breath to calm down when you feel angry.
examples.zh: 感到生氣時，深吸一口氣以平復情緒。

examples.en: He was angry with his classmate for breaking a trusted promise.
examples.zh: 他對同學違背可信賴的承諾感到很憤怒。

examples.en: I feel tired after a long day of classes.
examples.zh: 上了一整天的課我感到很疲累。

examples.en: After hours of continuous typing, my eyes felt dry and tired.
examples.zh: 連續打字數小時後，我的眼睛感到乾澀疲倦。

examples.en: She was tired of eating convenience store lunchboxes every single day.
examples.zh: 她厭倦了每天都吃便利商店的微波便當。

examples.en: Let's grab some snacks; I am really hungry.
examples.zh: 我們去買點點心吧，我真的很餓。

examples.en: Staying hungry for knowledge drives students to read broadly.
examples.zh: 對知識保持渴望驅使學生廣泛閱讀。

examples.en: The hungry stray dog was grateful for a bowl of clean food.
examples.zh: 飢餓的流浪狗對一碗乾淨的食物充滿感激。

examples.en: After running in the sun, I was very thirsty.
examples.zh: 在太陽底下跑步後，我感到非常口渴。

examples.en: The potted flowers look thirsty and need watering immediately.
examples.zh: 這盆花看起來缺水，需要立刻澆水。

examples.en: Curious students are thirsty for new scientific discoveries.
examples.zh: 好奇心旺盛的學生對嶄新的科學發現求知若渴。

examples.en: Jeremy Lin is a very tall basketball player.
examples.zh: 林書豪是一位非常高大的籃球員。

examples.en: Tall coconut palm trees line the beautiful tropical beach.
examples.zh: 高聳的椰子樹排列在美麗的熱帶海灘旁。

examples.en: How tall have you grown since the beginning of this year?
examples.zh: 從今年初以來你長高了多少呢？

examples.en: Take a short rest after studying for fifty minutes.
examples.zh: 讀書五十分鐘後，稍微休息片刻。

examples.en: She decided to cut her long hair into a stylish short haircut.
examples.zh: 她決定將長髮剪成時髦俐落的短髮造型。

examples.en: In short, regular practice is the secret to mastering any skill.
examples.zh: 簡而言之，規律練習是掌握任何技能的秘訣。

examples.en: We have a long summer vacation in July and August.
examples.zh: 我們在七八月有漫長的暑假。

examples.en: The Great Wall of China stretches across a remarkably long distance.
examples.zh: 中國萬里長城綿延極其漫長的距離。

examples.en: After months of lockdown, everyone longed for outdoor freedom.
examples.zh: 經過數月的封閉生活，大家都渴望戶外的自由自在。

examples.en: The Taiwan High Speed Rail travels very fast.
examples.zh: 台灣高鐵行駛得非常快。

examples.en: Cheetahs can run remarkably fast when chasing prey.
examples.zh: 獵豹在追捕獵物時能跑得極為飛快。

examples.en: Fast food tastes delicious but should not be eaten every single day.
examples.zh: 速食雖然美味，但不應該天天食用。

examples.en: Turtles are famous for their slow pace.
examples.zh: 烏龜以緩慢的步伐聞名。

examples.en: Drivers must slow down when approaching a pedestrian crosswalk.
examples.zh: 駕駛人在接近行人穿越道時必須減速。

examples.en: The movie scene was captured in artistic slow motion.
examples.zh: 電影場景以極富藝術感的慢動作鏡頭呈現。

examples.en: This math puzzle is easy to solve.
examples.zh: 這個數學謎題很容易解開。

examples.en: Take it easy over the weekend and get plenty of rest.
examples.zh: 週末放輕鬆點，好好充分休息。

examples.en: With modern apps, booking travel tickets is very easy and convenient.
examples.zh: 透過現代應用程式，預訂旅遊票券變得非常輕鬆便捷。

examples.en: If you work hard, you will succeed.
examples.zh: 如果你努力付出，你就會成功。

examples.en: Diamonds are among the hardest natural materials known on Earth.
examples.zh: 鑽石是地球上已知最堅硬的天然物質之一。

examples.en: It was a hard decision to move away from my hometown.
examples.zh: 搬離家鄉是一個艱難的抉擇。

examples.en: Please turn off your phone during the exam.
examples.zh: 考試期間請關閉手機。

examples.en: I will give you a phone call as soon as I arrive at the station.
examples.zh: 我一抵達車站就會立刻打電話給你。

examples.en: The receptionist answered the phone with a polite greeting.
examples.zh: 櫃檯接待員以禮貌的問候語接聽了電話。

examples.en: Almost every teenager has a cell phone nowadays.
examples.zh: 如今幾乎每個青少年都有手機。

examples.en: Don't look down at your cell phone while walking on the street.
examples.zh: 在路上行走時不要低頭滑手機。

examples.en: She downloaded a useful dictionary app onto her cell phone.
examples.zh: 她在手機上下載了一款實用的字典應用程式。

examples.en: We use computers in our information technology class.
examples.zh: 我們在資訊科技課上使用電腦。

examples.en: Cloud computing allows people to work on computers from anywhere.
examples.zh: 雲端運算讓人們可以在任何地方透過電腦工作。

examples.en: He learned computer programming to create his own video game.
examples.zh: 他學習電腦程式設計以打造屬於自己的電玩遊戲。

examples.en: Let's play a board game together tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚我們一起玩桌遊吧。

examples.en: Our school basketball team won the championship game yesterday.
examples.zh: 我們學校籃球隊昨天贏得了冠軍賽。

examples.en: Playing puzzle games can stimulate your brain and logical thinking.
examples.zh: 玩益智遊戲能刺激大腦思考與邏輯能力。

examples.en: Listening to soft music helps me relax.
examples.zh: 聆聽輕柔的音樂能幫助我放鬆。

examples.en: Traditional Taiwanese folk music features unique string instruments.
examples.zh: 台灣傳統民俗音樂具有獨特的弦樂器特色。

examples.en: She has a deep passion for composing original piano music.
examples.zh: 她對創作原創鋼琴音樂懷有深厚的熱忱。

examples.en: What is your favorite Mandopop song?
examples.zh: 你最喜歡哪一首華語流行歌曲？

examples.en: The whole audience sang the cheerful theme song together.
examples.zh: 全場觀眾一起齊唱了歡快的活動主題曲。

examples.en: Birds greeted the rising sun with a melodic morning song.
examples.zh: 鳥兒用悅耳的晨鳴迎接冉冉升起的朝陽。
